donationDiscovery.title: Donation model discovery
donationDiscovery.donation: Fetch models for all available keys in this donation
donationDiscovery.all: Fetch models for all available donation keys
donationDiscovery.donationHelp: Fetch models for every available key in this donation, including keys on other pages.
donationDiscovery.allHelp: Fetch models for available keys across all donations. Current filters and pagination do not limit this action.
donationDiscovery.eligibility: Only approved, unexpired, enabled and unsuspended keys with remaining quota are included. Automatic model lists are updated; manual entries and model bindings are preserved. Keep this page open to complete the batch.
donationDiscovery.running: Fetching models · {{processed}} of {{selected}} selected keys processed
donationDiscovery.paused: Fetching paused · {{processed}} of {{selected}} selected keys processed
donationDiscovery.resumeHelp: Already accepted checks can finish. Resume continues this run and reuses the request identity for any uncertain response. Reloading or leaving this page ends the batch controls.

status.conflict: Conflicting check; retry this key later

reasons.protocol: Upstream response could not be used

failurePolicy.label: Consecutive failure disable threshold
failurePolicy.help: Default: 10. Enter an integer from 0 to 340282366920938463463374607431768211455 without leading zeros.
failurePolicy.zeroWarning: Never disable automatically for errors: this key may still be called after repeated failures. Manual disabling, expiry, bans and quota limits still apply.
failurePolicy.recalculate: Saving preserves the failure count and immediately recalculates the error-disabled state. It does not enable the key or reset its failure count.
failurePolicy.invalid: Enter a valid consecutive failure threshold.

donationHandling.search: Search public description or donation ID
donationHandling.searchInvalid: Use at most 128 characters for this search.
donationHandling.conflictHint: Reload the current status before trying again if another manager has changed it.

help.legacy: Existing donations do not enter the shared follow-up queue.
help.pending: Administrators and stewards share this queue. Reviewing, editing or binding a donation does not mark it as processed.
help.processed: This donation has been processed for everyone.
help.closed: This donation ended and was removed from the pending queue.

pageControls.invalid: Enter a whole page number from 1 to 2147483647.

time.fold_later: This time occurs twice during a clock change. The later occurrence will be saved: {{local}} · {{zone}} (UTC{{offset}}).

keyLimits.title: Key request limits
keyLimits.hint: 0 means unlimited. Personal and charity model calls share these limits. RPM counts requests dispatched in the last 60 seconds; streaming occupies concurrency until it ends. When full, the next available connection is tried.

choices.noPageMatches: No matches on this page. Clear the filter or try another page.

sourceBrowser.searchInvalid: Use at most 128 Unicode characters and 512 UTF-8 bytes; control characters are not allowed.

sourceBrowser.noSourcesBody: No source groups match the current filters.

charity.saveOrderHelp: Save or cancel the order changes before adding or removing connections.
charity.namingHelp: Provider and model define the API name used on this site. Choose your own labels, then select the actual upstream models in service connections.
charity.operationHelp: Your client's API path selects chat completions or embeddings. Connect a service model that supports that operation. Tool-call flattening and store=false apply only to chat completions.
charity.embeddingBillingHelp: An embedding batch counts as one successful request. Token pricing uses the uncached input price for all inputs; vector dimensions add no output tokens.
charity.embeddingQuotaHelp: A successful embedding batch uses one call from the donation limit. Its token usage is the total input tokens, with no output tokens for vector dimensions.
charity.routeOrderedHelp: Try eligible resources in the saved connection order.
charity.routeRandomHelp: Each eligible connection has an equal chance of being selected.
charity.routeExpiryWeightedHelp: Expiry weights are 8 within 1 day, 4 within 7 days, 2 within 30 days, and 1 for later or unlimited expiry.
charity.noSourceGroupsBody: No source groups match the current search and scope.
charity.noSourceKeysBody: Try another source, scope, or search.
charity.keyUnavailable: This key is not eligible for a new connection.
charity.searchInvalid: Use up to 128 Unicode characters and 512 bytes; control characters are not allowed.
charity.candidateSearchInvalid: Use up to 512 Unicode characters and 2048 bytes; control characters are not allowed.
charity.crossSelectionHelp: Return to choose other donations and keys while keeping your selections. Add up to 100 at a time.
charity.accessLost: Charity management access is no longer available.
charity.confirmReview: I confirm this review result and its per-key consequences.
charity.deleteModelBody: This charity model and its service connections will be deleted. Requests already being processed are unaffected.
charity.modelChanged: This model has changed since you started editing. Your draft is kept. Reload the saved model before editing its latest version.
charity.reloadModel: Discard edits and reload saved model
charity.noAllowedLevels: No ordinary user can call this model (including level 5 users).
charity.publicDescriptionHelp: Line breaks are shown as entered. Markdown, HTML, and links are displayed as plain text.
charity.keyEditableAfterApproval: Key limits become editable after approval.
charity.terminalKeyImmutable: This key is no longer shared. Its charity settings are available to view only.
charity.noBindingsBody: Add one or more candidates below.
charity.pendingReviewBody: Before approval, enter usage limits, an end time and complete settings for every key that is still being shared. The donor description, donor-authorized latest end time, original service source and resource ownership cannot be edited here.
charity.tokenReserveCreditsHelp: Leave blank to inherit the global configuration.
charity.permanentAuthorizationHint: The donor authorized permanent use; the effective expiry may be finite or permanent.
charity.authorizedExpiryHint: The effective expiry cannot be later than {{value}}.

validation.priceLimit: Price limit must be an exact non-negative credit amount with at most three decimal places.
validation.countLimits: Call and token limits must be canonical integers no greater than 9,000,000,000,000,000.
validation.tokenReserve: Token reserve must be an integer from 0 through 2,147,483,647.
validation.safeNote: Reviewer-safe note must be at most 256 characters and contain no control characters.
validation.reviewReason: Review reason is required and must be at most 1,024 characters.
validation.expiry: Each effective expiry must be a valid supported date or permanent where authorized.
validation.expiryAuthorization: The effective expiry must stay within the donor-authorized limit.
validation.completeSettings: Approval requires a complete setting for every surviving key.
validation.modelIdentity: Provider and model are required, limited to 64 characters, and cannot reuse the [公益] prefix.
validation.modelLevels: Choose zero or more levels from L1 through L5.
validation.publicDescription: Public description must be at most 1,024 characters and 4,096 UTF-8 bytes, with no control characters except line breaks and tabs.
validation.modelPrices: Every price must be an exact non-negative credit amount with at most three decimal places.
validation.tokenReserveCredits: Reserve 0.001–9,000,000,000,000 credits, with up to three decimal places.
validation.discountPercent: Discount percent must be an integer from 0 through 100.
validation.discountDates: Discount dates must be valid and the end must be later than the start.

failureReset.title: Reset failure count
failureReset.help: Clears consecutive failures and the automatic failure stop. Enablement, limits and expiry stay as configured.
failureReset.resumeHelp: Continue to retry the interrupted request and process the remaining keys. Selection finishes before any reset begins.
failureReset.skippedHelp: {{count}} keys were skipped. The first 100 are shown below. Refresh and select again to retry conflicts or changed keys.

users.title: User management
users.description: Manage accounts, credits, access limits, and bans.
users.searchPlaceholder: Search by username or Discord ID
users.banSummary: Ban type: {{duration}}. The server invalidates this user's sessions and caller keys immediately.
users.unbanBody: The server will clear the ban state. Access remains subject to normal authentication and authorization.
users.elevatedPasswordHint: Used only for this confirmation; it is sent over the same-origin session request and not stored.
users.limitHint: Leave a limit blank to use the default. The default per-user concurrency is 5. Site, endpoint and key limits also apply to requests.
users.deletePasswordRequired: Enter the administrator password to continue.
users.emptyBody: No users match the current filters.
users.deleteRefreshOnlyBody: Enter your password to confirm. If the user record changes or the outcome is unclear, the page refreshes and you must confirm again.
users.deleteTypeConfirmation: Type {{token}} to confirm immediate account deletion
users.economyPositiveHint: The server ledger applies the selected direction to a canonical positive credit amount. A reason is required.
users.limitInvalid: Use whole numbers: endpoints 0–10000, RPM 1–4096, concurrency 1–100000. Leave blank to use the default.
users.readOnly: Your account and other stewards can be viewed here. Their settings cannot be changed.

announcements.description: Draft content remains private until an explicit publish or publish-update mutation.

detail.confirmDeleteBody: Content is permanently removed with no recycle bin; only a minimal content-free audit remains.
detail.confirmPublishBody: The current saved draft becomes the atomic user projection.
detail.confirmWithdrawBody: The current user projection disappears immediately.
detail.conflict: This announcement changed or the outcome is unclear. Your edits were kept; compare them with revision {{revision}} before confirming again.
detail.description: Preview uses the same bounded server renderer as publication.
detail.publishedHint: Published {{date}}. Editing the draft does not change this projection until Publish update.

announcements.draftHint: A draft may start empty. At least one language must have both a title and body before publication.
announcements.emptyBody: No announcements match the current filters.
announcements.title: Announcements
announcements.validation: Each language must contain both title and body or neither; each body is limited to 65,536 UTF-8 bytes, and expiry must be valid.
